competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Windermere regional overview pages. Region stat band, per-city comparison table from a single snapshot call, market FAQ plus FAQPage JSON-LD, Dataset JSON-LD for AI citability, and a broker lead-capture form no aggregator carries.
note: Region report page at /housing-market/central-oregon. A dedicated mockup is a follow-up deliverable; the page currently shares market-report/index.html. The CityComparisonTable replaces the legacy ~12-call per-city pulse fan-out with ONE getMarketPulseCitySnapshots call. MarketSnapshot with no citySlug serves the region aggregate via getRegionPulse.

requiredComponents.name: PageBreadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Home > Housing market > Central Oregon, includeJsonLd=false (schemas array on MetadataBlock handles the single BreadcrumbList)

requiredComponents.name: HeroBlock
requiredComponents.section: Full-bleed hero with display H1 'Central Oregon market report' in Amboqia via DisplayHeading, and data-driven lede from getMarketPulse region row.

requiredComponents.name: MarketSnapshot
requiredComponents.section: Region-level 4-stat band (no citySlug prop = central-oregon region aggregate). Active count, median list price, median DOM, months of supply + market verdict. Data from market_pulse_live geo_type='region'.

requiredComponents.name: PriceChart
requiredComponents.section: 12-month region median sale price trend, getPriceHistory('region','central-oregon','monthly',24) from market_stats_cache (89 monthly rows confirmed). Renders only when the series has >= 6 complete months.

requiredComponents.name: CityComparisonTable
requiredComponents.section: Per-city comparison table from ONE getMarketPulseCitySnapshots call. Replaces the legacy ~12-call per-city fan-out. Columns: city, active, median list, months of supply, median DOM. Each city row links to /housing-market/<city-slug>.

requiredComponents.name: FAQBlock
requiredComponents.section: Region market FAQ from buildMarketFaq, 4 to 5 Q&A pairs. includeJsonLd=true auto-emits FAQPage JSON-LD (G34).

requiredComponents.name: ContentSection
requiredComponents.section: Market narrative dynamically generated from region MoS verdict and live stats. Methodology trace citing market_pulse_live, geo_type=region, property_type=A, refreshed_at.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: Dataset JSON-LD (G34 AI-citability), breadcrumb, and webPage schemas. dateModified equals pulse.refreshedAt from market_pulse_live, never hardcoded. variableMeasured from buildMarketFaq datasetVariables.

requiredComponents.name: LeadCaptureBlock
requiredComponents.section: Broker inquiry form, variant='inquiry', tone='muted'. onSubmit=submitMarketPageInquiry. Framed as an inquiry, not a report-subscription promise.

requiredComponents.name: RelatedAreas
requiredComponents.section: City navigation tiles with live active counts from the same citySnapshots. eyebrow 'Central Oregon cities', cols=4.

requiredComponents.name: CTABar
requiredComponents.section: Broker contact band, tone='navy'. primary '/contact' Schedule a call, secondary 'tel:5412136706' 541.213.6706.

layoutComponents.name: SiteHeader
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

layoutComponents.name: SiteFooter
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

deferredComponents.name: PriceBandTable
deferredComponents.reason: No DAL price-band aggregation exists yet for the region level. Consistent with the city-page deferral in market-report-detail/parity.json.

required.note: Primary AI-citability signal. dateModified must equal regionPulse.refreshedAt from market_pulse_live geo_type='region'. Each variableMeasured value must equal the on-screen number (CLAUDE.md §0).

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts, market_pulse_live geo_type='region' geo_slug='central-oregon' property_type='A', 10 to 15 min freshness. Used for hero lede, narrative, and Dataset dateModified.
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts, market_pulse_live city rows for COMPARISON_CITY_LABELS, property_type='A'. ONE call replaces legacy ~12-call per-city fan-out. Used by CityComparisonTable and RelatedAreas.
dataLayer.note: All DAL functions imported from @/lib/data (G8 compliant). No @/app/actions/* imports. MarketSnapshot internally calls getRegionPulse (no citySlug prop) — the component owns that data fetch.
